commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

id.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

title.description: The user's title; the fallback when absent.

tags.description: Tags to start with; duplicates ignoring case keep the latest casing.

items.description: A free-form tag: 1 to 40 characters once trimmed, no control or format (zero-width) characters; stored trimmed, unique per session ignoring case.

groupId.description: A group on this environment to put the session in; none when absent or null.

anyOf.description: A group's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, kept in lowercase.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine: an absolute path, or one starting ~ for the environment's home.

oneOf.description: A directory the environment has: recorded at its absolute path, ~ expanded to the environment's home, . and .. resolved as written and symlinks kept; refused workspace_unusable, with its problem, when the environment cannot use it.

repository.description: Any path inside the repository; the worktree is made from its main checkout.

branch.description: An existing local branch to check out in the worktree.

name.description: The new branch's name; agent-harness/ and the session id's first eight characters when absent.

base.description: The ref the branch starts from, any ref; the main checkout's HEAD when absent.

newBranch.description: A branch the worktree is made on, made with it.

oneOf.description: A worktree the environment makes from a repository it has: from its main checkout (or bare repository), under the environment's worktrees root, locked for the session, with the ignored files the checkout's .worktreeinclude names copied in; on an existing branch, or on a new one (the new branch with its presets when neither is named), nothing fetched. Refused with the reason git's answer gives: not_a_repository, git_unavailable, no_commits, git_filters_refused, branch_exists, branch_not_found, branch_checked_out or git_failed.
A scratch directory of the session's own.

sessionId.description: The session on this environment whose workspace to share.

oneOf.description: Another session's recorded workspace on this environment, shared: its kind, path and repository identity.

workspace.description: Where a new session's code is to live: a directory, a new worktree, a scratch directory, or another session's workspace.

account.description: The account the session's runs use, one the environment holds and is signed in; the environment's default account at each run when absent.

model.description: The model the session's runs use; the adapter workstream's to validate.

mode.description: The mode the session's runs start in, clamped at each run; permissions.mode.set changes it.

browser.description: The session's first browser and who chose it, recorded as session.browser.set after session.created; none chosen (null) when absent. sessions.setBrowser changes it.

environmentId.description: The environment the Chrome is paired with.

anyOf.description: A paired Chrome's id: a UUID its environment mints when it pairs.

chromeId.description: The Chrome; null for the plain My Chrome, whichever of that environment's Chromes is connected.

oneOf.description: A Chrome paired with an environment.
The headless browser of the environment the run is on.
The browser dock in the desktop window.
No browser: the run reads the web with web_read alone.

value.description: A browser a session chose: a Chrome (a null chromeId the plain My Chrome), headless, the dock, or none.

chosenBy.description: Who chose it: person, or reach (the account's browser.reach default, as the client preset it).
